official_definition: (Once per Turn: Same Name) You can discard ten cards from the opposing decktop. Then, if there is any opposing cards being banished, destroy any number of opposing Spirits/Ultimates up to a total cost of 15.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [XV Crush] or [XV Crush: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [XV Crush]", "give [XV Crush]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mills cards from opposing decktop to Grave.
